title: Schelling's segregation model
experiment: Raising the like-neighbour threshold τ from 0 to a mild 0.3 sorts a mixed grid into homogeneous blocks, which is the claim of §2.
archetype_reason: The pattern emerges from households on a lattice each applying a local rule.

fixed.grid: 40×40 torus, Moore neighbourhood, two equal groups

source.quote: A household is content if at least a fraction τ of its occupied neighbouring cells hold its own group
Two groups of households live on a grid with some empty cells.

metrics.name: similarity
metrics.label: like neighbours
metrics.meaning: mean share of a household's occupied neighbours that are its own group

metrics.name: moved
metrics.label: moved
metrics.meaning: share of households that moved in the last round

reproduce.claim: At τ = 0.3, households end up with over 70% like neighbours.

source.quote: with τ = 0.3, households end up with well over 70% like neighbours

contrast.claim: At τ = 0 the share stays near its random level, at least 0.15 below the τ = 0.3 run.

source.quote: With τ = 0 nobody moves and the mix stays at its random level, about half like neighbours.
